text: A T. rex tooth, root and all, could be as long as a banana!
About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun!
A group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'. Fancy!
Velociraptor was only about the size of a turkey, and it had feathers!
The Moon drifts about 1.5 inches farther from Earth every year. That's about how fast your fingernails grow!
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood!
A hummingbird's heart can beat more than 1,200 times a minute!
Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old, was still safe to eat!
A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus!
Saturn is so light for its size that it would float in a bathtub, if you could find one big enough!
Sloths can hold their breath for up to 40 minutes underwater!
The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived, even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs!
Butterflies taste their food with their feet!
An ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain!
Argentinosaurus was almost as long as three school buses parked in a row!
Triceratops had a beak like a parrot and hundreds of teeth in its cheeks!
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth!
Astronauts' footprints on the Moon could last for millions of years, because there's no wind to blow them away!
A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun!
Snowflakes almost always have six sides!
Penguins can't fly in the air, but they 'fly' underwater using their wings as flippers!
Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so they don't drift apart!
Babies are born with about 300 bones, but grown-ups have only 206. Some bones join together as you grow!
A cheetah can go from standing still to 60 miles per hour in about 3 seconds!
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm that is bigger than the whole Earth!
Pteranodon wasn't a dinosaur. It was a flying reptile with wings wider than a car is long!
Birds are living dinosaurs. A chicken is a distant cousin of T. rex!
Koalas can sleep up to 20 hours a day!
Grown-up elephants can't jump. They always keep at least one foot on the ground!
There are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on all of Earth's beaches!
A group of owls is called a parliament!
A snail's tongue is covered in thousands of tiny teeth!
A sea star doesn't have a brain, but it can still find its food!
A shrimp's heart is in its head!
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur!
A giraffe has seven bones in its neck, the same number as you!
Honeybees dance to tell other bees where to find flowers!
Most frogs don't drink with their mouths. They soak up water through their skin!
A baby kangaroo, called a joey, is about the size of a jelly bean when it's born!
Elephants can feel rumbles through their feet from far away!
Dolphins sleep with one half of their brain at a time!
Owls can't move their eyes, so they turn their heads almost all the way around instead!
A group of jellyfish is called a smack!
Hippos can't really swim. They walk and bounce along the bottom of rivers!
A woodpecker can peck up to 20 times every second!
Bats are the only mammals that can really fly!
A dog's nose print is one of a kind, just like your fingerprint!
Some turtles can breathe through their bottoms while they sleep underwater all winter!
A ladybug's bright spots warn birds that it tastes yucky!
A caterpillar has thousands of muscles, far more than a person!
A fish called the mudskipper can walk on land and climb up tree roots!
Pound for pound, spider silk is stronger than steel!
An ant can carry things many times heavier than its own body!
Sharks have been around longer than trees!
An axolotl can grow back a lost leg!
A blue whale's heart is about as big as a bumper car!
Sloths move so slowly that tiny green plants grow in their fur!
Some parrots can live for more than 50 years!
A rhino's horn is made of the same stuff as your fingernails!
No two zebras have exactly the same stripes!
A camel's hump stores fat, not water!
Goldfish can remember things for months, not just a few seconds!
Cheetahs can't roar, but they can purr like a house cat!
The Arctic tern flies from near the North Pole to near the South Pole and back every year!
Hummingbirds can fly backwards!
Seahorse dads carry the babies until they hatch!
Flamingos are pink because of the shrimp and algae they eat!
Koalas have fingerprints a lot like people's!
Venus is the hottest planet, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun!
Mars has the biggest volcano in the solar system. It's more than twice as tall as Mount Everest!
A day on Jupiter is only about 10 hours long!
Neptune has the fastest winds in the whole solar system!
The Moon has moonquakes!
There's no air in space, so astronauts bring their own inside their spacesuits!
Saturn's rings are made of ice and rock. Some pieces are tiny, and some are as big as a house!
Moonlight is really sunlight bouncing off the Moon!
The Sun is a star! It looks so big because it's the closest star to us.
Uranus spins on its side, like a ball rolling around the Sun!
A year on Mercury is only 88 days long!
The International Space Station goes all the way around Earth about 16 times a day!
Comets are like giant snowballs made of ice and dust!
Shooting stars aren't stars. They're tiny space rocks glowing as they zoom through the sky!
Your heart beats about 100,000 times every day!
You blink about 15 to 20 times every minute!
The smallest bone in your body is inside your ear, and it's about the size of a grain of rice!
Your tongue has thousands of taste buds!
You're a tiny bit taller in the morning than at bedtime!
Your brain uses about one fifth of all your body's energy!
Fingernails grow faster than toenails!
Try it: you can't hum while holding your nose closed!
The Pacific is the biggest ocean on Earth!
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above the sea!
The Sahara is the biggest hot desert in the world!
Antarctica is the coldest and windiest place on Earth!
About 70 percent of Earth's surface is covered by water!
Lightning flashes about 40 times every second somewhere on Earth!
A rainbow is really a whole circle. From the ground we usually see only half!
Some volcanoes are hidden deep under the ocean!
The Amazon rainforest makes a lot of its own rain!
Snow is really clear ice. It looks white because of the way light bounces around in it!
Stegosaurus was almost as long as a school bus, but its brain was only about the size of a lime!
Spinosaurus was even longer than T. rex and spent lots of time in the water!
Some dinosaurs were as small as chickens!
Dinosaurs lived on every continent, even Antarctica!
Ankylosaurus had a big bony club on the end of its tail!
The word dinosaur means 'terrible lizard'!
Scientists who dig up and study fossils are called paleontologists!
Some kinds of bamboo can grow about 3 feet in a single day!
Young sunflowers turn to follow the Sun across the sky!
Some trees are more than 4,000 years old!
Strawberries wear their seeds on the outside!
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not!
A pineapple takes about two years to grow!
Apples float in water because they're about one quarter air!
The first carrots were purple and yellow, not orange!
Peanuts aren't really nuts. They're beans that grow underground!
Potatoes were the first vegetable grown in space!
Water can be a solid, a liquid or a gas: ice, water and steam!
Sound travels about four times faster through water than through air!
Every magnet has a north end and a south end!
Hot air rises. That's how hot air balloons float!
Glass is made from melted sand!
Rubber comes from the sap of rubber trees!
The Wright brothers' first airplane flight in 1903 lasted only 12 seconds!
Long ago, people cleaned their teeth by chewing on twigs!
The ice pop was invented by an 11-year-old boy!
Earmuffs were invented by a 15-year-old who had cold ears!
The Great Wall of China is thousands of miles long!
People around the world speak about 7,000 different languages!
A baby goat is called a kid!
A group of lions is called a pride!
Cats sleep about 12 to 16 hours a day!
Many dogs can learn more than 100 words!
Wood frogs can freeze in winter, then thaw out and hop away in spring!
Squirrels plant lots of trees by forgetting where they buried their nuts!
An octopus can change color in less than a second!
Some penguins give a smooth pebble as a present!
Horses can sleep standing up!
A duck's feathers are waterproof!
A giraffe's tongue is dark purple and about as long as your arm!
Bees have five eyes!
Tigers have stripes on their skin, not just on their fur!
A baby elephant can stand up within about an hour of being born!
Crickets hear with ears on their front legs!
Earthworms don't have eyes, but they can still sense light!
Some sharks glow in the dark!
A rabbit's teeth never stop growing!
Fireflies make light without getting hot!
Pandas spend about 12 hours a day eating bamboo!
